### Read the Bible: Numbers 25, Psalm 68, Isaiah 15, 1 Peter 3
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/numbers-25-psalm-68-isaiah-15-1-peter-3/
Passage: Numbers 25
Points:
- Moab defeated Israel not by military curses, but by seducing them into sexual immorality and idolatry.
- Israel's greatest danger came when they abandoned their covenant distinctiveness and provoked God's wrath.
- Phinehas's decisive execution of the rebellious couple upheld the theocratic covenant and halted a deadly plague.
- Far from being senseless violence, his actions were a principled intervention that saved thousands of lives.
- Believers and the modern church must stay vigilant against cultural compromise and self-serving spiritual compromise.
